verdict.rationale: Firecrawl documents a hosted scraping API, managed browser sessions (Browser Sandbox), and page interaction such as clicking and filling forms. None of the evidence shows a way to upload, build, or deploy custom serverless scraping scripts that run on Firecrawl's platform. Calling hosted endpoints, or driving a managed browser session, is an adjacent capability and not deploying your own code.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build and deploy custom serverless scraping scripts on the platform without managing my own infrastructure
